item.title: Overview of Jeremiah - The Weeping Prophet and the Faithful God 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Imagine a village perched on the edge of a vast plain, a place where life moves with comforting predictability. Every morning the farmers walk the same worn paths to their fields, confident that the seasons will behave as they always have. Elders gather beneath the shade of an ancient oak, telling stories of past deliverance, stories so familiar that no one questions them anymore. Children grow up hearing that their village is blessed, protected, chosen. Nothing truly bad can happen here, or so everyone believes.
